messages:
sam.sales: Kicking off handoff for AcmeCloud joint POC. Partner needs architecture + security answers before their procurement call on Wed. They called out BYOK, VPC peering, and estimated load ~50 qps. Who can take this?

marta.ae: I'll own the partner comms and pricing side. Do they want Redwood Dedicated or a hosted starter? They also asked about short-term credits for POC.

leah.pe: I can take architecture. Quick clarifying q: do they require on-prem or is VPC peering to our Private offering sufficient? Also need the model list — they mentioned Llama2-70B and a smaller fallback.

jordan.se: Recommend starting Dedicated (predictable latency) with VPC peering + option to test on Hosted for rollout agility. For HSM/BYOK we can integrate via KMS bridge.

priya.security: @sam.sales please share the security questionnaire link. Top asks likely: SOC2, BYOK flow, key rotation, and access control. They also flagged HIPAA — is this true or just a checkbox?

sam.sales: Sharing their SQ here: https://acmecloud.example/sq/12345. They did mark HIPAA and encryption at rest as mandatory. They specifically asked: "Can Redwood support customer-managed keys and audit logs for inference requests?"

leah.pe: Proposed high-level arch draft for discussion:
```
Client -> Partner Edge (TLS) -> VPC Peering -> Redwood Private (ENIs)
  -> Dedicated GPU Pool (model variants)
KMS (customer) <-> BYOK bridge (for envelope keys)
Fallback route -> Redwood Hosted smaller model (auto-fallback)
Logging -> Audit stream -> Partner SIEM
```

leah.pe: I'll put a diagram in Confluence. Perf targets? What should we shoot for in the POC?

jordan.se: Baseline: p95 <= 100ms for 512 tokens, concurrency 80 sessions. If we hit that, justify Dedicated sizing. Infra cost estimate for 2-week POC: roughly $3k-$4k (GPU hours + networking).

marta.ae: For pricing, partner asked if we can do pooled billing across their customers during the POC window. I'll propose a short-term credit + discounted Dedicated hourly rate and confirm with finance.

priya.security: I'll own the SQ responses. Need: a) proof of encryption-at-rest, b) KMS integration docs, c) rotation policy, d) runtime audit sample + retention window. Please avoid sending PII samples. Also preference for E2E encryption with BYOK.

leah.pe: Can someone from the Acme ops team share their network CIDR and an SRE contact? We need to pre-authorize IPs and prepare peering firewall rules.

marta.ae: Partner contact is tony@acmecloud.com and ops@acmecloud.com. CIDR proposal: 10.10.0.0/16. I'll do the intro once we finalize the runbook.

sam.sales: Action items summary:
- @leah.pe -> architecture diagram + infra runbook by EOD Tue
- @priya.security -> security questionnaire draft and attachments by Wed
- @jordan.se -> perf targets, load profile, and infra estimate by Tue
- @marta.ae -> partner intro, pricing note, and credit proposal
I'll schedule a joint enablement call for Thu 10:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: Thu 10:00 PT — Invites sent to participants.

marta.ae: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short slide deck for the partner workshop and include the commercial template.

leah.pe: Noted. I'll include a minimal runbook with commands for peering, sample dockerized runtime, and a snippet for audit configuration:
```
# sample audit config
redwood.audit.enabled=true
redwood.audit.stream=partner-siem
redwood.kms.mode=BYOK
```

priya.security: If anyone needs specific wording for the contract (BYOK liabilities), ping me and I'll draft language.

sam.sales: Great work, team — let's reconvene after docs are up. Thanks!
